reason: I pay the contractors myself by bank transfer, so I already know what went out. If someone sends the same receipt twice, I call them about it. I don't need another subscription to tell me that.
objection: A duplicate or a padded receipt means I can't trust the person, and a bot doesn't fix that. It's one more $19 a month I'd cancel after two months of not opening the sheet.
would_change_my_mind: If it caught real money I'd missed in my own old chat history during the free trial, like a double-paid invoice from my contractor.
